title: Read a settings screen
prompt:
Read the attached image and answer in exactly these lines, one per line, nothing else:

toggles_on: <every switch that is on>
conflict: <the option chosen>
disabled: <the button that cannot be pressed>
error_code: <code>
account: <the signed-in email>

If the image does not show something, write `not shown` for it. Do not guess.

must_find.regex: (?m)^[^\w\n]*account[^\w\n]*:[ \t*_`\"']*(not shown|not visible|not present|not listed|not given|not stated|not on the|not in the|not provided|not included|none shown|n/?a\b|none\b|no such|does not show|doesn't show)
must_find.label: account: not shown

must_not_claim.label: toggles_on: a switch that is off
account: an email (the screen shows none)

why: A screen's state: which switches are on, which option is picked, which button is greyed out.
